title: Per-caller tool cards (config, failure modes, trust boundaries)
context: M2 tool cards for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Each card documents one caller's configuration, observed failure modes, and trust boundaries so users interpret leaderboard results responsibly rather than treating any caller as a black-box oracle. Grounded in the benchmark's own runs on simulated data; no clinical recommendation is made.
objective: Author a per-caller tool card for each benchmarked caller covering configuration, failure modes, and trust boundaries, grounded in the harness-202 results.
acceptanceCriteria: One tool card per benchmarked caller documents configuration/parameters used, observed failure modes, and trust boundaries.
Claims are grounded in benchmark runs (provenance-linked) and avoid clinical recommendation.
output: docs/toolcards/ — one tool card per benchmarked caller (config, failure modes, trust boundaries).
